title: Native engine and accounting scope isolation

audit.notes: 本地 HEAD 不是 origin/main 最新（云端 52a600e3 / 本地 ba91c6d4）——按 §1.2 先对齐基线

invariants.text: 租户边界覆盖数据库 RLS、运行时上下文、事件、缓存和外部连接器。
经营事件、审批和关键回执只增不改；纠正通过新事件表达，不静默覆盖证据。
所有外部或变更性动作及其子调用，统一经过权限、PII、围栏和审批链路。
涉钱、敏感数据、群发、公开发布、交易和破坏性变更必须按高风险处理并由人审批。
没有真实回执就不能标记完成；mock、模拟和体验模式在数据结构与界面上都要明确区分。
客户原始经营数据不得上行；蜂群只接受白名单化、最小化、匿名化且可审计的元数据或派生经验。
租户覆盖层只能收紧围栏，不能放宽平台不可变红线。
模型、提示词、技能、bundle、策略和热更新必须先评测再灰度，且始终可回滚。
platform-ops、平台账户运营和平台秘密只属于 Andromeda。
Tiger 在获得单独的合规审查和用户明确授权前，只能模拟或纸面交易。
令牌、密码、API key、私钥、客户凭证和私密客户数据不得进入源码、文档、上下文、提示词、日志或提交。
个性化与行业扩展不得形成公共机制的第二事实源。

cards.title: Global vendor engine bridge crosses concurrent native run provider and billing identities

evidence.note: Independent 8c fixture reproduced both original run requests sent to tenant-B engine; ba91 still has same global closures. Native handoff restriction test at ba91 also fails after vendor run returns.

cards.trigger_path: Concurrent startRun A/B replaces shared vendor prototype with B closure; A uses B provider/sink. Native handoff starts after VideoStudio restriction scope closes.

assertions.given: Concurrent native vendor requests, direct/routed transports, nested runs, custom structured options, absent/closed/tampered scope
assertions.expect: Each run keeps its own engine/provider/billing sink; no-scope, late and tampered dispatcher calls perform zero external submissions; all adapter options and source limits persist through native handoff.

cards.fix_plan: Install only fixed vendor dispatchers, route through AsyncLocalStorage with active run engine and closed lifecycle. Native task wraps full runner, and marketing limits cover post-vendor handoff. Correct reasonStructured three-argument forwarding.
cards.blast_radius: Native preproduction model calls and billing sink scopes; no vendor source writes, token changes, parallel pipeline or media resubmissions.
cards.rollback: Revert scoped dispatcher commit; keep current native archives; stop concurrent production rather than routing through another identity.
cards.notes: Source-use prompt propagation does not prove semantic compliance; final system qualification is unchanged. Independent acceptance remains separate from repair.
